The '''Ketaris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]].
